newsitem.title: ITALY: Parmalat surges in Milan on Beatrice buy.
newsitem.headline: Parmalat surges in Milan on Beatrice buy.

text.p: Shares in Parmalat Finanziaria, Italy's largest quoted food group, firmed strongly on the Milan stock market after Friday's announcement it was buying a majority stake in Canada's Beatrice Foods.
"They've made an interesting purchase. If the operation works well we'll have to revise upwards forecasts for Parmalat's results," one Milan trader said.

The Italian milk and dairy products group is allying itself with U.S. bank Citicorp in the deal, with Parmalat paying C$230 for a 75.1 percent in the Canadian food group which has a similar milk and dairy-based product mix to Parmalat.
Citicorp will take the remained 24.9 percent of the group which has a majority of its sales in Canada and the remaining near-20 percent of turnover in the United States.
At 0947 GMT, Parmalat was quoted 6.78 percent up at 2,315 lire in volume of over three million shares.
